AppChange.description:
A value already in the app that confirming this workbook will replace (scores and
homework grades follow the workbook — Phase 8.1 rule; this only makes it visible).
AppChange.title: AppChange

ClassroomUpdate.description:
Admin class management (2026-11-20): rename (e.g. a typo) and end / resume operation.
Ending keeps every record and hides the class from daily screens; the class type is fixed.
ClassroomUpdate.title: ClassroomUpdate

ClientAddressDiagnosis.description:
How the server sees the caller's own request (deployment check, admin only, off by
default). Holds only the caller's addresses and proxy hops — never the edge secret.
ClientAddressDiagnosis.title: ClientAddressDiagnosis

PasswordChange.description:
SEC-10-A. The length rule is checked by the service so the answer can say what is
wrong (the generic request-validation error would not).
PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange

PasswordResetCodeIssued.description: SEC-10-B: shown once to the administrator; never stored or logged in clear.
PasswordResetCodeIssued.title: PasswordResetCodeIssued

PasswordResetComplete.description: SEC-10-B: set a new password with a one-time code issued by an administrator.
PasswordResetComplete.title: PasswordResetComplete

ProgressColumn.description:
One column of the grid: a lesson (with its linked assessments) or a stand-alone
assessment that is not linked to any lesson.
ProgressColumn.title: ProgressColumn

RecordUpdate.description:
Correct one student's record for one lesson in a single transaction.

Omitted fields are kept. ``prework_grade``/``weekly_grade`` set to null clear the grade;
attendance can be changed but not cleared. ``result_version`` is the lesson_result version
the client saw (null when there was no record yet).
RecordUpdate.title: RecordUpdate

SheetSummary.description: A sheet (time slot) of the workbook that holds class blocks.
SheetSummary.title: SheetSummary

StudentContactUpdate.description: Guardian contact edit (Phase 8). Omitted fields are kept; null or "" clears a field.
StudentContactUpdate.title: StudentContactUpdate

StudentListItem.description: All-students view (administrators only), with every class the student is enrolled in.
StudentListItem.title: StudentListItem

TodayLesson.description: Result of "오늘 수업 시작": today's first-session lesson, created only if missing.
TodayLesson.title: TodayLesson

TodoItem.description: One class lesson with unfinished parent notices (dashboard '성적 안내 할 일').
TodoItem.title: TodoItem

request. Enabled only with ACADEMY_PROXY_DIAGNOSTICS=1; turn it off again afterwards.

post.description:
SEC-10-A: change one's own password (current password required, CSRF, other sessions
revoked). Wrong current password: 400 — not 401, which would end the session client-side.

SEC-10-B: set a new password with the one-time code an administrator handed over. No
session is needed (the member cannot log in); the code is the proof. JSON only, like log-in
(cross-site forms cannot send it), and limited like log-in attempts.

delete.description: Deletes a class with no records only; otherwise 409 CLASSROOM_HAS_RECORDS.

patch.description: Rename a class or end / resume its operation (records are always kept).

post.description: Parse and match only; nothing is written.
The workbook's time-slot sheets, so the user can choose what to upload. Reads no data.
